title: Vessel Movement Plan
description: Offshore Supervisor's planned vessel movements for the next 48 hours. The simulator treats this as the FORECAST for plan_date and plan_date+1. When the actual daily-vessel-report for those days lands, it overrides the relevant slices of this plan.

plan_date.description: The 'today' date of the plan — the date shown in the email subject ('Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. DD-MMM-YYYY'). Plan narrative covers this day plus 'Tomorrow'.

issued_date.description: Calendar date the supervisor sent the plan (typically same as plan_date, in the evening).

issued_role.description: Free-text role / title (e.g. 'IODS Operations Supervisor (Offshore Project), HPM').

narrative.description: Full plain-text body of the email / extracted PDF text — preserved verbatim for reference.

current_status.description: Bullet describing the vessel's position/state at the moment the plan was written (today's bullet).

tomorrow_plan.description: Bullet(s) describing the planned next-day movements.

additional.description: Any remaining narrative bullets (return legs, conditional plans).

notes.description: Free-text supervisor notes specific to this vessel.
